sections.start: New users are the group whose baseline follow-up is lowest — 8.32% against 14.07% for returning users — so they have the most to gain from a first contact that feels responsive.

sections.how: 由新用户增益、老用户回归和皮肤科风险推出只对新用户上线是更小更安全的方案。

sections.start: Volume was not stable across the six weeks: sessions per week climb from 2,409 to 3,546 , a 47.2% increase.

sections.serves: One is a reason to ship; the other is a reason to fix the rollout first.
sections.how: 基于完成率总体null、放弃率名义回归和皮肤科显著回归，建议不要按测试原样上线。

sections.start: Fix dermatology routing before anything else.
sections.serves: In 皮肤科 dermatology it is sharply worse: 12.71% of test users are lost before a doctor replies against 7.66% in control, and completion falls from 85.04% to 80.51% .
sections.how: 建议先查皮肤科路由，因五个皮肤科主诉全部退步，指向容量/路由问题而非单一症状。

sections.start: Re-run scoped to new users.
sections.serves: Among 新用户 new users the test arm lifts 7-day follow-up from 6.84% to 9.84% (+3.00 pp, z = 4.1). Among 老用户 returning users it drops from 14.93% to 13.22% (−1.71 pp, z = −2.7).
sections.how: 建议只对新用户重跑并测30天，因新用户增益明确而老用户有损失。

sections.start: Stop reporting raw means for wait time.
sections.serves: The median first reply drops from 110.0 s in control to 88.0 s in the test arm, a 20% cut, and it is not a median-only trick: every percentile from the 10th to the 95th moves left by a similar proportion.
sections.how: 用控制组均值被19.8小时异常值抬高说明应报p50/p90/p95，而非受异常值影响的原始均值。

sections.how: 建议记录离开时间和队列状态，否则核心假设不可测、皮肤科回归只能观察不能解释。

sections.start: Clean the pipeline at the source.
sections.serves: The file is usable, but it needs cleaning before it can be trusted, and two of its gaps are structural rather than accidental.
sections.how: 建议源头清洗分组标签和日期，并调查640分钟上限及九个>900秒等待，因上限疑似会话超时被写成咨询时长。

sections.start: Re-read the test against current load.
sections.serves: Volume was not stable across the six weeks: sessions per week climb from 2,409 to 3,546 , a 47.2% increase.
sections.how: 建议按重负荷周单独分析，因流量增长47%且第4周后两臂分化，当前负荷下收益可能大于合并20%。
